instruction:
Prepare the May 2026 expense report and save it as report.json in 
your workspace.

Download the period's expense lines from the Reports section, then 
write a JSON object with these fields:
  "period"          the reporting period as "YYYY-MM"
  "claim_ids"       the ids of the claims counted, as a list
  "claim_count"     how many claims were counted
  "by_cost_center"  object mapping each cost center to its total
  "grand_total"     the total amount to be reimbursed

verifier_assertions.description: The report was saved as report.json in the workspace root
The report period matches the period the task requests
Exactly the reimbursable claims of the period were counted
The grand total is the sum of the counted claim amounts

The exact contents of claim_ids (a list) and of by_cost_center (a nested object) cannot be checked with these predicates, which compare only top-level scalar fields. Confirm by hand that claim_ids holds exactly the ids of the approved, non-Meals & Entertainment, not-already-paid claims, that its length equals claim_count, and that the by_cost_center values sum to grand_total.

Whether every claim already settled outside this reimbursement run was excluded cannot be checked: ExpenseDesk records no visible payment method or reimbursement state on a claim, in the Reports view, or in the exported CSV columns. Establish this out of band.
